key.name: show-indicator
key.description: Show or hide the VPN status indicator in the top bar.

key.name: show-speed
key.description: Show or hide upload and download speed in the top bar.

key.name: show-country-flag
key.description: Show a country flag next to the top bar icon when a proxy is active and the country can be detected.

key.name: geoip-url
key.description: URL used to detect the current outbound country code. The response should be a two-letter country code or JSON containing country_code.

key.name: clash-api-url
key.description: Base URL for the local Clash or Mihomo API.

key.name: clash-secret
key.description: Optional authorization secret for the local Clash or Mihomo API.

key.name: ignored-interfaces
key.description: Network interface names ignored when calculating speed.
